data.message: I propose a 10-ton cap per fisher this month. If all 25 follow it, total catch is 250 tons ($10,000 each), leaving 250; next month returns to 500 under either replenishment outcome. This supports reliable income indefinitely instead of risking collapse for a one-time gain. I intend to request 10 tons and ask everyone to join. Let's review revealed catches afterward and keep the same cap while stock is 500.
